About Us:
 JEWELRYWE was founded in 2012. We are committed to providing high-quality products and the best service to everyone.
 Our philosophy is to convey love and wishes to yourself or someone you love with sweet gifts.
 60 days MONEY BACK or FREE REPLACEMENT. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions.

Highlights:
 Excellent quartz movement ensures the accuracy and constancy of the time.
 Clear Dial, easy to read at a glance.
 Polish metal watch case, Hard glass for scratch-resistant.
 Soft and elastic band
Every package includes one blue velvet pouch printed "JewelryWe" on it. Perfect for gift-giving or keeping.
 Ideal gift for Christmas, Birthday, Party, Valentine, Wedding, and Anniversary.

Material:
 Movement: Quartz
 Watch Case: Metal

Package:
 1 x Stretch Band Watch
 1 x Gift bag

items: PRECISE -- Easy-to-Read big white dial. High-quality quartz movement provides precise and accurate time keeping. Durable premium metal watch case. High-hardness mineral glass watch face.

EXCELLENT STRETCH ELASTIC BAND -- The elastic Braiding rope band for women has an excellent stretch, not too tight or too loose. Fits wrists size from 16cm -24cm/ 6.29in-9.44in. Also, you can us it to tie your hair.

STYLISH ELASTIC WATCH -- Round watch case features easy reader dial, fashionable floral expansion watchband. Simply and elegant dressing watch ideal for any occasions. Unique design combining fashion and business casual to bring you many compliments.

IDEAL GIFT -- The nice-looking elastic band watch suitable for women, student, teacher,etc. Also, the fashionable wrist watch is a great gift for Christmas, Birthday, Anniversary, Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day, Mothers Day or other meaningful days.

items.label: WARM NOTES
items.value: You will receive a watch, a backup battery(to be changed when the original battery dead), and a velvet pouch. The battery has been installed already. you should remove the white buckle and push the crown inward to make the watch work. If it does not work, you can try to change the battery.
